questions.prompt: Why are text-delta chunks announced but never written to the event log?
options: The finished assistant/message event records the full text, so the deltas are only for showing progress
Deltas are too private to record
The model needs the deltas in its next request
questions.explanation: The assembled assistant/message is the fact. Deltas are commentary for screens, so a missed one loses nothing.

questions.prompt: A browser tab opens while the agent is mid-turn. How does it show the right state?
options: It waits for the next turn to start
It replays all the deltas it missed
It reads the log so far as a snapshot, then follows events with a higher sequence number
It asks the model to repeat its last answer
questions.explanation: The log holds every fact. The seq acts as a cursor, so the tab reads up to the newest seq and then listens for later ones.

questions.prompt: What is gained by announcing on event hooks instead of printing inside the loop?
options: New screens can be added as plugins without editing the loop
Events no longer need sequence numbers
Only one screen can watch at a time, which avoids conflicts
questions.explanation: The core only emits; each screen subscribes. Adding a terminal, a page or another program means adding a listener, not changing the core.
